brief_title: A Phase III Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Petrelintide in Participants With Overweight or Obesity and Established Cardiovascular Disease
official_title: A Phase III, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo Controlled, Parallel Group Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Once Weekly Petrelintide Vs. Placebo in Participants With Overweight Or Obesity And Established Cardiovascular Disease

primary_outcomes.measure: Percentage Change in Body Weight from Baseline

brief_summary: This study will evaluate the efficacy and safety of petrelintide compared with placebo, in conjunction with a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity, for weight management in participants living with overweight or obesity and established cardiovascular disease (CVD).

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participants with BMI ≥ 27 kg/m² and established CVD
* History of at least one self-reported unsuccessful dietary effort to lose body weight

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known history of Type 1 diabetes mellitus
* Current or previous treatment with petrelintide or any other amylin analog
